quotes.author: Carol W
quotes.text: We rented Kayaks for their Creek location in Sandwich. The service was wonderful. They carefully outfitted my grandsons with life jackets and even had a wet bag we could rent (since we foolishly forgot ours) for a nominal fee. We didn't do a tour as we kayak often but their suggestions were excellent and the boys especially loved when they told them not to let us do all the work.

quotes.author: June D
quotes.text: What a fun and enjoyable experience we had with our kayak guided tour with Kyle! In the Mashpee location. Our family was celebrating a birthday and wanted a memorable experience together. Kyle was great and it was a nice combination of exploring the beautiful scenery and homes and ocean. Would highly recommend!

quotes.author: Kristi F
quotes.text: Best way to rent a kayak for your Cape vacation - they bring it to you and then come back and pick it up. They also have a sweet spot on Scortons Creek where they will literally put the boat in the water and help you ship off. Super friendly and laid back too.

quotes.author: Roslyn S
quotes.text: Everyone was great. The kayaking was AWESOME. It was low tide and very little wind. We did the whole creek. We are seniors and weren’t sure we would make it,but it was a piece of really delicious cake. Thanks for the adventure.

quotes.author: Nikki K
quotes.text: We had a great time cruising Scott on creek in kayaks . Mike was our guide and was excellent! Informative, helpful and we enjoyed the entire experience from launch to back to shore. Highly recommend this trip for all
